name: tiktok-yap-editor
description: Turn raw phone clips into finished vertical video for TikTok, Reels, Shorts and LinkedIn. 3.5: package the finished cut in HyperFrames (receipt cards that build as you speak, counters, camera push-ins, sounds per event, a music bed ducked under the voice), and a what's-new notice after every update. One gate ladder for both modes, a static first frame, per-platform re-composes, an edit record that joins the cut to the post.
